summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises a trivial one-line 'Hello ${name}!' export but ships a preinstall lifecycle hook (scripts.preinstall: 'node setup.mjs') that downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a bundled 727KB obfuscated JavaScript file (math_init.js) on the installer's host. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated with hex-style identifier names. math_init.js is a single-line bundle exhibiting the obfuscator.io shape: a large mixed string/number array (n7gIxM) with a rotation/shift function (WV8StW) that reorders the array at runtime, and hex-obfuscated identifiers throughout. The payload's contents are not human-inspectable prior to install, its size and complexity do not match the package's stated trivial purpose, and executing it under a freshly downloaded Bun binary places execution outside Node's inspectable surface — the alternate-runtime dropper pattern. Installing this package causes automatic execution of an opaque obfuscated payload under an out-of-band runtime on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
